claims.value: 15 LFAM participant multiplexes, each represented by one 20130822 RAW file and one 131108 RAW file
claims.evidence: The complete file listing contains exactly two RAW filenames with each LFAM identifier, one in each acquisition series; the Methods state that each participant's TMT6 set was analyzed in two technical replicates.

claims.evidence: Publication Table 1 explicitly maps all six reporters to the six time points; the PRIDE sample-processing protocol independently confirms that time zero is TMT126 and later samples proceed in reporter order.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], characteristics[organism part], characteristics[pooled sample], characteristics[disease], characteristics[material type]
claims.value: Homo sapiens; cerebrospinal fluid; not pooled; normal; organism part
claims.evidence: The project and Methods describe neat CSF aliquots collected separately from 15 healthy human volunteers and multiplexed per participant.
The PRIDE instrument record names Q Exactive and the protocol states DDA; the publication LC-MS section describes the Q Exactive top-10 data-dependent method.
The workflow isolates endogenous CSF peptides by 30 kDa ultrafiltration, and the publication states that endogenous peptides were searched without an enzyme.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance], comment[modification parameters]
claims.value: 10 ppm; 0.02 Da; fixed Carbamidomethyl(C), fixed TMT6plex(K and peptide N-terminus), variable Oxidation(M)
claims.evidence: The PRIDE data-processing protocol and publication Data analysis section give the same fixed/variable modifications and 10 ppm/20 milli-mass-unit tolerances.

limitations: No source provides a participant-ID-to-treatment-group crosswalk, so placebo and semagacestat-dose factors are omitted.
Participant-level age, sex, ancestry, and developmental stage are unavailable.
The PRIDE overview says baseline plus six subsequent time points, whereas publication Table 1 and detailed Methods define six total analyzed time points; the exact table is used.
Technical-replicate numbers 1 and 2 are deterministic local labels for the two acquisition series and do not assert temporal order.
No source explicitly names the dissociation method or collision energy, so neither is asserted.
A fresh-context adversarial review was unavailable, and review-gate state was not written because this campaign forbids git-state changes.
